body:
Freeze and carry rules for Termal::Merger packages (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-11 02:38Z; a supplement to termal-merger-model-2026-10-10, which is at its size limit).
1. CARRY. On this machine the system core.autocrlf=true makes `git apply` write CRLF while the index stays LF. Carry with `git -c core.autocrlf=false apply …`, or write the files from their index blobs (`git -c core.autocrlf=false checkout-index -f -- <paths>`).
2. FREEZE. A schema-1 fingerprint computed by the reference script under the system Git config never passes the pinned host checker, which uses an isolated config (w-3a48a8c03da7). Always freeze under core.autocrlf=false (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=core.autocrlf GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false), on an LF working tree.
3. VERIFY before reporting ready, with the pinned checker: "C:\github\Personal\TermAl\target\release\termal.exe" review-freeze-check ROOT MANIFEST FP must exit 0 with stdout exactly FP plus LF. It runs no server and opens no store.
4. The review evidence rests on the staged blob ids. A re-freeze with byte-identical blobs needs no new pair; record the superseded fingerprint and why.
5. Package notes name the fingerprint's KIND (schema-1, or a labelled launcher composite) plus the blob ids. On a mismatch, compare the blob ids first.
Incidents: w-4cdb (composite b22eed66 versus schema-1 a2be1050), w-8f9a (CRLF after git apply), w-d3e9 (2b107063 from the system config, superseded by r4).

6. COMMIT FROM THE INDEX (Fable2, 2026-10-11 05:23Z, after w-d3e9's 76e1819d). The working tree under the system autocrlf=true holds CRLF; the reviewed and gated input is the LF index. Commit only what is staged: run plain `git commit` with no pathspec and no re-add, or `git write-tree` plus `git commit-tree`. Never `git commit -- <paths>`, `-a`, or a re-add under core.autocrlf=false, all of which store the CRLF working files. Before any handoff, check that `git diff --stat BASE COMMIT` shows only the package's real hunks (no whole-file churn) and that each committed blob id equals the frozen staged blob id. Incident: 76e1819d stored all four w-d3e9 files with CRLF (+14360/−13998); the evaluation caught it (criterion 4 insufficient), and it never reached master.
